prompt_deviation: lines starting with # stripped; positions already in canvas fractions (no conversion)
refs_note: 1-3 cut-outs of the old M0 r2 graded v3 (sofa, coffee table, armchair: look only); 4-13 = m0-v7 product close-ups: cube, pendant, jar, NYOKO, boucle, sage knit, throw, runner, holders, bowl (round-5b clay, house plan 1.2.2)

args.prompt:
Use the attached clay render as the exact blueprint. Keep every wall, opening, window, cornice, skirting, floor and ceiling line, the camera, and the position, size and angle of every furniture piece and built-in exactly as in the clay. Move, resize, add or remove nothing. Each placeholder shape marks one product below; render it there at the stated size. Only turn the clay into real materials and light. x, y are fractions of the image from the top-left.

SCALE: the clay is also the size of everything: the 220 cm sofa spans x 0.47-0.87, back top y 0.60, legs at y 0.92; the 140 x 70 cm coffee table spans x 0.46-0.78, far edge y 0.77, legs cut by the bottom edge; the 72 cm armchair spans x 0.05-0.32 from y 0.70 down, cut by the bottom edge only; the window x 0.06-0.30. Furniture is small in this 24 mm frame by design: never enlarge a piece to fill the frame or to match a cut-out; if a piece looks too small, keep the clay's size.

1. PHOTO. Top Scandinavian interiors magazine: a Copenhagen living room, 3 pm mid-winter, 24 mm shift lens at 1.2 m, level, straight verticals, all sharp. Close and generous: the armchair the cut foreground, the low silk pendant glowing over the table.

CUT-OUTS. Images 1-3: cut-outs of a photograph of this room from one metre farther back (1 sofa with cushions and throw, 2 coffee table group, 3 armchair): materials, colour, grain and light only, never framing, position or size. Images 4-13: close-ups of the exact products: match form, colour and texture.

2. LIGHT. Winter daylight, no sun: soft north light from the left window; outside, bare birches and pale sky, no snow, no buildings. Exposed bright, for white: the back wall by the corner almost white, just under the glowing window reveals; the window wall in soft shade, a clear half stop darker than the back wall, never grey. The glass is the brightest, with detail. Long soft shadows right and toward the camera; dense contact shadows. Real contrast, never milky. 4600 K: walls a clean warm white, never cream, yellow, pink or grey. Lamps 2700 K, low, shadowless: the pendant glows from inside with a soft pool on the bare table centre; the cubes wash short soft fans up and down the wall.

3. MATERIALS. Matte mineral paint #F4F1EC, faint chalky movement. Wide oiled white-oak planks, pale honey #D6BF9E. Sofa: slubby oatmeal cotton-linen #E6DCCB, tapered oak legs. Table and armchair frame: oiled oak #C8A27A, satin, a long soft highlight on the table top. Armchair cushions: mist-grey wool boucle #D9D6D0.

4. PRODUCTS, one per line, each on its clay placeholder:
b. TRAVERTINE CUBES at the two ends of x 0.52-0.85, y 0.33-0.39: two 12 cm cubes of warm honed travertine, open pores, light out of top and bottom.
c. PENDANT, x 0.57-0.66, y 0.12-0.23: a flat ribbed warm-white silk lantern, 40 cm, on a thin black cord from the top edge.
d. CURTAINS, x 0.02-0.33: sheer natural linen-blend, S-fold, slim black rod, backlit, hems on the floor, front panel cut by the edge.
e. VASE on the sill, x 0.23-0.26, y 0.46-0.62: a 31 cm cream distressed clay jar, 3-4 eucalyptus stems.
h. RUG under the table, x 0.17-1.00 from y 0.79 down: white hand-woven flat wool, tone-on-tone diamond weave, fine grey flecks.
i. CUSHION, sofa left: 50 cm warm-white boucle.
j. CUSHION before it: 45 cm sage chenille knit.
k. LUMBAR, right seat: 30 x 50 charcoal linen-look.
l. THROW over the right arm, x 0.76-0.84: thin crinkled cream cotton muslin, short frayed fringe.
m. RUNNER across the table's left third, x 0.50-0.60: sage-grey linen-look, fringed ends.
n. CANDLE HOLDERS, x 0.67-0.69: two hand-sized travertine pedestals, unlit candles 15 and 10 cm.
o. BOWL beside them, x 0.70-0.75: 21 cm warm-white matte belly bowl, empty.

5. NOT IN FRAME: anything on the wall above the sofa but the two cubes (no art, frame, mirror or wall decor), floor lamp, wall lamp, basket, plant, pouf, magazines, books, cable, text, people, snow. No sun patches, beams, bloom, haze, halos, HDR, grain or vignette.
